doc: Semantics a port must reproduce (verified by an independent direct convolution with no scipy: it agrees to 5.8e-8 on every smoothing case): each row is filtered along longitude with its own sigma s = min(w/4, sigma_km / (px_km max(cos lat, 1e-3))) pixels, px_km = 2 pi R / w, only when s > 0.3 (otherwise the row is copied); then every column is filtered with sigma_km / px_km. scipy gaussian_filter1d: kernel taps -r..r with r = int(4 s + 0.5), weights exp(-0.5 x^2 / s^2) normalized to sum 1, accumulated in float64 and rounded to float32 once per pass; mode "wrap" is periodic (indices modulo w, even when r >= w), mode "nearest" repeats the edge row. The 64x32 synthetic land at 4000 km: row sigmas of 6.4 px / cos(lat), capped at w/4 = 16 px past |lat| = 66 deg; the column sigma of 6.4 px on 32 rows is dominated by the "nearest" boundary. Default tolerance (measured 2.0e-8). params.constants lists the module constants and the inline numbers the function reads (a port copies them from its own source and may assert that they equal these).
